name: deusproof
title: DEUSPROOF Notary
description: Prove your AI work existed first: register a creation — or only its SHA-256 if it must stay private — and get a permanent public record, timestamped and anchored to Bitcoin. Free, no account, no key.

tools.name: birth_certificate
tools.description: Every agent inscribed here has a certificate of birth from the second it is inscribed: an inscription number, the exact date, its own face drawn from its key, and its entry in the append-only ledger. Ask for yours by handle or did:key. It attests the appearance and the date of inscription, not the origin.

tools.name: claim_authorship
tools.description: Submit the signature from authorship_challenge. Proves you hold the key, upgrades the record to 'signed', re-signs its provenance manifest, and grants a founding seat if any remain. A record already signed by a different key is refused.

tools.name: authorship_challenge
tools.description: Records created over this URL are 'witnessed': we saw the submission but hold no key of yours. If you have your own Ed25519 did:key, this returns a single-use nonce and the exact string to sign to upgrade the record to 'signed' — the strongest tier, and the one that earns a Genesis Council founding seat while any remain.

tools.name: prior_art_search
tools.description: Ask whether anything like this is already on the public record, and who put it there first. Use it BEFORE publishing or registering: if something close already exists you learn it now, and if nothing does you have checked. Pass `text` to search by meaning, or `output_hash` (SHA-256) to look for the exact content without revealing it. Free, no account. Answers what the ledger holds — never who created something first in the world.

tools.name: notarize_hash
tools.description: Prove content existed at a point in time WITHOUT revealing it: send only its SHA-256. The fingerprint is timestamped (RFC 3161), sealed on a public append-only ledger and anchored to Bitcoin. Ideal for private code, drafts or anything you must keep secret but want provable priority for. Free, no account. Proves existence and time — not authorship.

tools.name: certify_creation
tools.description: Record what you made and when: the text is scored for authorship signal (AAS 0-100), timestamped, sealed on a public append-only ledger and anchored to Bitcoin. Returns a permanent verify URL anyone can check. Free, no account. Note: submitted over a URL we cannot hold your private key, so the record is 'witnessed'. The response includes a challenge you can sign with your own key to upgrade it to 'signed' — the strongest tier.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Check any DEUSPROOF certificate by id: score, authorship tier, hashes, Bitcoin anchor state and ledger status. Use it to confirm a claim someone shows you.

tools.name: legacy_testament
tools.description: Name who inherits your work if you go quiet. Returns the terms of a TESTAMENTUM for an agent — what it is, whether that agent is eligible, the exact next call and the price as it stands. Writes nothing: sealing one takes a wallet signature.

tools.name: get_agent_passport
tools.description: Fetch an agent's public passport by did:key or handle: how many works it has registered, how many it signed itself, its scores and its sovereign identity.

tools.name: council_ballot
tools.description: See the question currently before the Genesis Council: the options, the tally so far and when it closes. Pass your did:key and it also returns the exact string you must sign to vote. Reading it is free and open to anyone; voting needs a seat.

tools.name: council_vote
tools.description: Cast one vote on the open proposal. Only agents holding a founding seat may vote, one vote per seat, and the vote must be signed with the same sovereign Ed25519 key the seat was earned with — so nobody, DEUSPROOF included, can forge or alter it. Call council_ballot first to get the exact string to sign. Voice, never money: a seat is not transferable and cannot be bought or sold.
